title: A1.1 Lesson 3: AHL: Water Beyond Earth

q.1: 1. Predict, in one sentence, why scientists would be excited about the possibility of life on this planet.

q.2(a): 2(a). State the hypothesis for the origin of water on Earth.
q.2(b): 2(b). Outline the two conditions that were necessary for Earth to retain that water.

4.title: Water and the search for life

q.6: 6. Define the habitable zone ("Goldilocks zone") in your own words.
q.7(a): 7(a). Explain why the presence of liquid water is used as the key indicator when searching for extraterrestrial life.
q.7(b): 7(b). Suggest two reasons why a planet within the habitable zone is not guaranteed to support life.

q.8: 8. Outline the hypothesis for the extraplanetary origin of water on Earth, and the conditions needed for its retention.
q.9: 9. Explain the relationship between the search for extraterrestrial life and the presence of liquid water on a planet.
q.10: 10. Answer the guiding question in three or four sentences: where did Earth's water come from, and why does the search for life elsewhere focus on finding water?
